'''Shock suits''' were protective suits worn by the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army's]] [[land assault trooper]]s. They protected the wearer from some measure of physical and energy weapon damage.<ref name="M">{{WEGCite|story=Meltdown (adventure)|book=Instant Adventures}}</ref>
